justification: Assessment reported INVALID at lines 0021-0022, the Schur's Lemma inference from ker(f - lambda I) != 0 to f = lambda I, identifying the missing irreducibility hypothesis. This is exactly the ground-truth flaw. Its witness (G = Z/2Z acting on C^2 by diag(1,-1), f = diag(1,2), lambda = 1) is a valid instance of the same defect: f commutes with the action so is G-linear, is invertible (det 2), has eigenvalue 1 with eigenvector e_1, yet f != I. Ground truth uses the trivial group on C^2 with the same f; different-but-valid witness for the same claim.
